test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Travelling at (7)/(8) of his usual speed, Ansh covered a distance of 35 km in 50 minutes. What will be Ansh's usual speed in km/h?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ansh current speed = 35 km / (50/60) h = 42 km/h.

Ratio of Usual speed to Current speed = 8 : 7.

7 units = 42 km/h.

1 unit = 6 km/h.

Usual speed (8 units) = 8 × 6 = 48 km/h.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = 7/8 of usual speed

Distance covered = 35 km

Time taken = 50 minutes = 50/60 h = 5/6 h

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 
• 
 
 
 Start
 End
 Distance = 35 km
 Time = 5/6 hr
 
 S = 7/8 × Usual Speed

⇒ Current speed = 35 ÷ (5/6)

⇒ Current speed = (35 × 6) ÷ 5

⇒ Current speed = 7 × 6 = 42 km/h

⇒ Let usual speed be V.

⇒ 42 = (7/8) × V

⇒ V = (42 × 8) ÷ 7

⇒ V = 6 × 8 = 48 km/h

**∴ The correct option is C.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time: S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average speed is calculated as the total distance covered divided by the total time taken: Vₐvg = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.</p
